pages.text: Mobs you kill yourself sometimes drop their $(item)Trophy$(). $(thing)Looting$() raises the odds; the base chance is in the server config.$(br2)Place it as a small statue and right-click it: many trophies react, like the chicken laying an egg or the creeper hissing. Each reaction has a cooldown.

Trophies are $(bold)data-driven$(): a datapack adds one with a single JSON file in$(br)$(code)data/<namespace>/opencubes/trophy/<name>.json$()$(br2)Killing that entity can then drop it. Trophies load with the world, so restart the world after editing them ($(code)/reload$() is not enough).

$(code)entity$(): entity id, required.$(br)$(code)scale$(): statue size, default 0.4.$(br)$(code)vertical_offset$(): lift in blocks, default 0.$(br)$(code)behavior$(): right-click reaction, default $(code)opencubes:none$().$(br)$(code)drop$(): used by $(code)opencubes:item_drop$(), with $(code)item$(), $(code)count$() (1), $(code)cooldown$() in ticks (20000) and $(code)sound$().

Built-in reactions: none, item_drop, blaze, breeze, cave_spider, creeper, enderman, evoker, guardian, guardian_spike, iron_golem, llama, mooshroom, pufferfish, rabbit, shulker, skeleton, snowman, squid, villager, witch.
